description: Na₃HfF₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.47 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.27 Å. Hf⁴⁺ is bonded in a distorted pentagonal bipyramidal geometry to seven F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Hf-F bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.07 Å. There are five inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Hf⁴⁺ atom. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Hf⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Hf tetrahedra. In the third F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Hf⁴⁺ atom. In the fourth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Hf⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Hf tetrahedra. In the fifth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Hf⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Hf tetrahedra.
